title: Music racing game I made in my custom engine (mostly hand-coded)
author: dfgungor
selftext:
Heya!

I had been working on a rhythm/racing game for the the last 1.5 years in my custom engine (SDL3 C++) that I've written the old way until 3 months ago.   


The game does realtime audio analysis and drops obstacles and pickups as you go (similar to games like Audiosurf). You can play any music file (mp3, wav) without any preloading or waiting.

The only AI involvement is in the code since last 3 months to speed up the process and test different ideas. The audio analysis pipeline was already built manually during 2025 (much pain😅).

All art in the game is procedurally generated, music and logo are human-made. It was especially smooth using agents on my existing hand-written codebase.

Demo is out, I would appreciate if you try and wishlist  
[AuraLane on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4192140/AuraLane/)
